C0878.title: Modifying User ID to Achieve Horizontal Privilege Escalation and Tamper with Another Account's Password
C0878.summary: A Qi-An-Xin offensive and defensive community Q&A lists common test points for password change functions: if the server does not effectively verify the user's identity or ownership of the target object, an attacker may modify ID parameters to change another account's password. Weak old-password checks, SMS-code binding, CSRF protection, or input validation may also lead to arbitrary password reset, verification-code abuse, or logic-bypass risks.

references.title: Qi-An-Xin Offensive and Defensive Community: Logic Issues in Password Modification During Penetration Testing
